data: Apple delivered a solid fiscal 2025, with revenue rising 6.4% to $416.2 billion from $391.0 billion in fiscal 2024. Profitability improved at every level. Gross profit climbed to $195.2 billion in fiscal 2025 from $180.7 billion in fiscal 2024, equal to a fiscal 2025 gross margin of 46.9%. Operating income reached $133.1 billion in fiscal 2025, up from $123.2 billion in fiscal 2024, for a fiscal 2025 operating margin of 32.0%. The bottom line was the standout: net income grew 19.5% to $112.0 billion in fiscal 2025 from $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024, and diluted EPS rose to $7.46 from $6.08. Apple kept investing while doing so, lifting R&D expense to $34.5 billion in fiscal 2025 from $31.4 billion in fiscal 2024. We view the results as evidence of durable earnings leverage.
